plain: Baby steps, updated as they happen. Each line is one concrete thing being done right now; done lines stay for the day so you can see the trail.

steps.text: Confirmed the Render site is live and serving the latest build
Recorded that All-22 film has no painted first-down or scrimmage lines: field registration anchors on yard numbers and the official line of scrimmage instead
Added this 'Right now' block and a one-line command that logs a step and pushes it
Designing the correction loop: how the owner fixes what the model gets wrong, and how that feeds back
Designing ingestion (drop a file, press Analyze) and the live pass / post pass model
Closed milestone 0: planning done, open items moved to where they belong
Milestone 1: frame source interface, video probe, proxy rendition, per-play clips, film-window detection
Milestone 1: NFL API client port (token client, game detail, rosters, teams, stat types)
Milestone 1: play record schema v1, official-only records for every play, fz-export
Milestone 1: artifact manifests and the stage runner with skip-if-unchanged
Verified the NFL API port live: real game detail, rosters, labels merged by play id; milestone 1 closed
